recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血中血小板明顯偏多、散布整個視野，白血球僅見少數嗜中性球、單核球與淋巴球，紅血球大小不一且部分色淡；血小板增多合併貧血時，需以骨髓鐵染色找環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）來診斷伴環狀鐵粒母細胞與血小板增多之 MDS/MPN（MDS/MPN-RS-T）。
features: Increased platelets scattered throughout the field, including occasional large forms
Mild anisocytosis with a subset of paler, hypochromic-appearing red cells (possible dimorphic population)
Normal-appearing segmented neutrophils without obvious dysplasia at this power
Occasional monocytes and lymphocytes; no blasts seen
No nucleated red cells or teardrop cells evident
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows thrombocytosis with scattered large platelets. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with a suggestion of a paler hypochromic subpopulation. White cells include segmented neutrophils, occasional monocytes and lymphocytes, without blasts or leukoerythroblastic features. The blood findings are nonspecific; in a patient with anemia and thrombocytosis, they are compatible with myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis, which requires bone marrow iron stain and SF3B1/JAK2 studies for confirmation.

ddx.vs: ET shows thrombocytosis without anemia, dimorphic red cells or marrow ring sideroblasts of 15% or more.
Iron deficiency causes thrombocytosis with uniformly hypochromic microcytes and absent marrow iron, rather than ring sideroblasts.
MDS-RS has a normal or low platelet count, whereas MDS/MPN-RS-T requires a platelet count of at least 450 x 10^9/L.
Congenital forms present young with microcytosis and without thrombocytosis or clonal SF3B1/JAK2 mutations.
